purpose: Transfer JANUS canonical analytical 5D Spiral as a provenance-aware mosaic of native time/frequency evidence, with reversible kaleidoscope views as invariance checks (never independent votes), and a separate visual-only sampled-frame QC adapter for shared TOPA Retina.
adaptation_status: The numerical mosaic and mirrored invariance checks are new experimental signal-processing operators; they are not claimed to be a pre-existing canonical kaleidoscope code implementation.

dimensions.D1: time forwards/backwards at a fixed native candidate path; check score invariance and four-block persistence
dimensions.D2: native frequency mirror plus inverse index map; parity check only, never duplicated independent evidence
dimensions.D3: four-by-four mosaic is a navigation/diagnostic view; native resolution is scored and retained
dimensions.D4: retain competing noise/coherent/shared hypotheses; no automatic signal-origin verdict
dimensions.D5: hash source and reference native arrays, check caller-attested scan identity and same native grid; attestation alone is not physical TCS/IF proof

input_contract.radio: 2D native (time,frequency) finite numeric data, optional matching independent OFF; no JPEG power input
input_contract.video: 3D sampled grayscale frames from already source-bound TOPA Retina manifest, visual-only QC; preserve original video SHA256 and frame PTS externally

comparison.comparator: direct matched mean on same 3-slope bank with same rowwise robust normalization and sidebands
comparison.controls: synthetic Gaussian noise, impulse interference, weak/strong source-only lines and shared source/reference line
comparison.calibration: 80 synthetic noise-only arrays; separate seeded synthetic 200-case evaluation; threshold p95 computed independently per method; diagnostics only
comparison.scientific_limits: No real authenticated radio frames evaluated; no physical IF mapping, independent scan confirmation or astronomical false-alarm calibration; test generator is simplified; July/September viewed experiments cannot become new blind holdout.

gates.engineering: Nine local unit/integrity tests must PASS; parity/determinism/provenance/non-mutation, TOPA manifest SHA256 and PTS validation
gates.science: HOLD: independently replay matched native Parkes/GBT measurements and new untouched sessions against frozen R41S/R42 and direct matched filter; require zero protected weak losses at matched realized controls and confidence intervals by independent parent scan
gates.production: HOLD and separate authorization; no false-alarm suppression, no hard veto
